title: LECTURE AND PRESENTATION METHODS FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS
description: Develop and improve comprehension and notetaking of lectures in an academic format. Give individual and group presentations. Develop skills in cross-cultural communication styles, non-verbal communication, questioning techniques, and clarifying information.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways level students.
meeting_html: MWF 2pm-3:50pm in *ILLC Room TBD (ILLC TBAD) (9/23 to 12/4)
